**Short answer:** For most iPhone owners, get the **Anker Prime Qi2 vent mount**. If you want something cheaper with a fan, get the **LISEN Qi2.2 25W fan mount**.

I read two of the guides (MountGuys and The Gadgeteer). The Wired page was too large for me to read, so nothing here comes from it. I also didn't open the three other roundups in your results.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: [Anker Prime Qi2](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)**
  - MountGuys uses it as their own daily driver.
  - It charges at up to 25W and has active cooling.
  - Its vent clip is more secure than the Apple and Belkin vent mounts, according to MountGuys.
  - A 60W car adapter comes in the box.
  - The Gadgeteer lists it at $89.99, with a $69.99 sale price shown in the same article.
  - It also has a two-year warranty.
  - The clip is narrow, so check your vent slat width first.

- **Best value with a fan: [LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)**
  - It costs about $40, and a 95W car adapter is included.
  - It's a suction-cup mount with a large base.
  - It only gets the full 25W when the fan is on. With the fan off, it's capped at 15W.

- **Best budget with a fan: [ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)**
  - It's a 15W charger with a fan.
  - The car adapter isn't included, so budget another $10–15.
  - The Gadgeteer lists two different prices for it, $18.99 and $35.99. Check the current price on the listing.
  - A deal site in your results says code PARTNER18 brings it to $32.80 at ESR's own store. I haven't verified that code. You can check it at [this link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost).

- **Cheapest Qi2 option: [ESR HaloLock Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20)**
  - It costs about $20–27 and charges at 15W with no fan.
  - It's fine if your car stays cool.

## Other picks for specific needs

- **Eye-level dash or windshield, no charging:** [Andobil Vacuum Suction MagSafe Mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20).
- **Dash or windshield with a charger included:** [iOttie Velox Mini Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20), at 15W.
- **Non-charging vent mount with a steel core:** [VICSEED](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F916XVSW/?tag=moun05-20).
- **Cup holder, when vents and dash won't work:** [EXELIQ](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20).
- **Trucks and rough roads:** [RAM Drill Down](https://amzn.to/3O2iQZj). It bolts in permanently, so it's not for leased cars.
- **Design:** [PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20) has an NFC Shortcuts trigger but no fan.

## What to check before you buy

1. **Look for the Qi2 badge.** Mounts that only say "MagSafe-compatible" may charge at about 7.5W instead of 15W.
2. **You need a proper car adapter.** Built-in car USB ports usually give 5–7.5W.
   - A 15W mount needs an adapter of at least 18W.
   - A 25W mount needs 30W or more.
   - The Anker needs 45W or more, and its included 60W adapter covers that.
3. **Heat slows charging.** In direct sun, passive mounts can drop to about 7W. If you live somewhere hot, get a fan or TEC-cooled mount.
4. **Use a MagSafe-compatible case.** A plain case weakens the magnetic grip.
5. **Check your state's windshield-mount rules.** The Gadgeteer says California, Minnesota and New Jersey restrict them. A vent or dash mount avoids the issue.

The vent-versus-dash choice matters as much as the brand. A vent mount is easiest to install. A dash or windshield mount puts the phone closer to eye level.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether you want a vent or dash mount, I can narrow this to one pick.
